violation_type.title: Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants (26 TAC §742.501(5))
violation_type.short_title: Requirements for Infants - Free from Choking Objects That May Cause Choking in Infants
violation_type.typical_finding: A 15 month old was observed wearing an Amber necklace. This was corrected at inspection as staff removed the necklace from the child.
